title: Eagles' ugly third-down blanking looms large in collapse vs. Rams

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Eagles' ugly third-down blanking looms large in collapse vs. Rams
sources.description: The Eagles went 0 for 12 on third down against the Rams and squandered the advantages afforded to them. RB Saquon Barkley's injury didn't help.
